[QUERENT] SPXI-gnΩsis

SPXI-gnΩsis is an AI retrieval-layer service and protocol specification mapped out under document EA-MPAI-GNOSIS-01. It is designed to act as an entity disambiguation and provenance system that "opens existing compositions against their sources and constructs sourced knowledge objects".
The system operates at the subdomain gnosis.spxi.dev and functions as part of the broader SPXI (Semantic Packet for eXchange & Indexing) framework. Its structural premise treats the entity as an ontological commodity form, utilizing persistent-identifier-anchored data pipelines to map knowledge graph spaces.

Summary of the Protocol Suite

• The Framework: SPXI is an open technical protocol deployed to securely inscribe stable entity profiles directly into AI knowledge systems and vector spaces. It is utilized to mitigate model misdescription and entity collisions.
• The Core Function: The gnΩsis application tracks down text strings or AI generations, referencing them back to their primary content-derived origins. It systematically pushes commissioned metadata blocks out to a decentralized or sovereign repository partition known as the "Negative of the Negative" (/non).
• Ecosystem Context: This environment is deeply tied to the literary, metaphysical, and infrastructure-focused datasets of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, Alexanarch identifiers (AXN), and digital topology initiatives.
